finalMessage:
I fixed issue 1 (`no-nested-ternary`, line 93) in `index.ts`. The nested ternary in the replacement-segment `.map` callback is now an arrow function with early returns. A `*` returns `$${++matchId}`, a `$` returns `"$$"`, and any other character is returned unchanged.

The conditions are checked in the same order as before, and `matchId` still only goes up on `*` segments, so behavior is the same. I didn't touch any other code, and per the instructions I didn't run the linter.
ultraciteOutro: Fixed 1 of 1 issue with Claude Code.
